name: check_availability
description: Find open appointment slots. Call when the patient wants to book or asks what times are available. Do not invent slots — this returns real availability from Google Calendar.

date.description: Target date YYYY-MM-DD, or null if the patient didn't specify one

service_type.description: e.g. cleaning, consultation; null if unknown

name: book_appointment
description: Book a specific slot the patient has explicitly confirmed. Only call after check_availability and an explicit confirmation.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 start time with timezone offset

name: reschedule_appointment
description: Move an existing appointment to a new confirmed time.

appointment_id.description: Known appointment id, or null to look up the patient's upcoming appointment

new_scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 start time with timezone offset

appointment_id.description: Known appointment id, or null to look up the patient's upcoming appointment

name: escalate_to_human
description: Hand the conversation to clinic staff. Call for emergencies, explicit requests for a person, or when you cannot help.
